body:
Replaced project, card, milestone and report source files with one validated JSON envelope: type, metadata and body. Descriptions and comment text remain Markdown strings; folders, hours/durations, checklist items and human/bot comment history retain their structured fields. Conditional writes, retries and durable filesystem behavior remain in place.

Converted all 72 existing test resources across both registered projects while the daemon was stopped, retained original backups, and verified every value through the restarted server. Both projects validate without issues, and the existing HTTPS address, pairing, settings and command epoch are retained. Old Markdown journal entries are preserved but cannot be undone after this format change; new JSON history supports normal undo.

The full local gate, all 15 browser suites across the recorded runs, broad HTTPS smoke and planning gestures pass. Evidence and the initial Focus timing sensitivity are documented in progress/2026-09-26-json-sources.md. Physical iPhone and complete release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Use one JSON envelope for all project resources
